overview: GranViT proposes a fine-grained vision encoder trained via a two-stage pretraining-adaptation framework on the Gran-29M dataset, incorporating Bbox2Caption and Caption2Bbox tasks along with localized self-distillation to enhance fine-grained visual perception for Multimodal Large Language Models.

modules.name: Gran-29M Data Curation Engine
modules.description: Implements the data construction pipeline including filtering criteria based on image resolution, aspect ratio, and bounding box area/count, as well as the reformatting of annotations into Global Caption, Bbox2Caption, and Caption2Bbox QA pairs with relative coordinate conversion.

modules.name: Granular Dataset Loader
modules.description: Handles loading image-text pairs, applying image transformations such as resizing to the target resolution with aspect-ratio-aware padding, and implementing custom sampling strategies to balance natural and OCR data distributions.

modules.name: GranViT Network Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone, the 2-layer MLP Projector, and the integration interface for the Large Language Model, supporting initialization from pre-trained vision encoders and the image tiling strategy for high-resolution inputs.

modules.name: Regional Feature Alignment & Self-Distillation
modules.description: Implements the localized self-distillation logic, including ROIAlign operations on student features, feature extraction from image crops using the teacher encoder, and the computation of the MSE distillation loss between aligned representations.

modules.name: Stage 1 Pretraining Controller
modules.description: Manages the pretraining stage where the LLM is frozen, optimizing the Vision Encoder and Projector using Global Caption and Bbox2Caption tasks, while integrating the self-distillation loss to enforce explicit localization constraints.

modules.name: Stage 2 Adaptation Controller
modules.description: Manages the adaptation stage where the Vision Encoder is frozen, optimizing the Projector and LLM using Global Caption and Caption2Bbox tasks to strengthen the LLM's localization capability using fine-grained visual features.

modules.name: Autoregressive Loss Computation
modules.description: Calculates the autoregressive cross-entropy loss for textual generation tasks (captions) and processes coordinate prediction for grounding tasks, ensuring supervision is correctly propagated back to the respective model components.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Computes core evaluation metrics including ACC@IOU0.5 for bounding box localization, ROUGE-L for captioning quality, and accuracy scores for fine-grained, VQA, reasoning, and OCR benchmarks.

modules.name: Attention & Grounding Visualizer
modules.description: Generates attention maps for specific query tokens to visualize regional focus and plots predicted versus ground truth bounding boxes for the Caption2Bbox task to facilitate qualitative analysis and error inspection.

modules.name: Ablation & Scaling Experiment Configurator
modules.description: Configures experimental setups for analyzing scaling laws by varying data scale sizes and for ablation studies by selectively removing components like self-distillation or specific training stages.

modules.name: EMA & Checkpoint Manager
modules.description: Implements Exponential Moving Average updates for the teacher vision encoder weights and handles the saving and loading of model states for seamless transitions between pretraining, adaptation, and downstream SFT stages.

modules.name: Experiment Orchestrator & Logger
modules.description: Manages configuration files for hyperparameters, controls the training workflow logging, and aggregates evaluation results to generate comparison tables and performance curves.
